character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A lone rift-blade swordsman channeling void energy. Dark teal hooded long coat with glowing cyan trim, a flowing cyan scarf, dark navy pants, worn leather boots and belt. Tan skin, short dark hair, glowing cyan eyes under the hood. Wields a slender glowing cyan-white energy longsword with a faint rift aura. Athletic, agile build, confident heroic stance. Dark fantasy style, clean bold silhouette, limited palette of dark teal, deep navy, and bright cyan accents.
